title: Simple Bake — bookkeeping for pastry makers and small bakeries
lead: Orders, customers, recipes, inventory and documents in one app instead of a notebook, notes and spreadsheets.

tasks.label: Orders
tasks.text: Take an order, set the date and items, see the status and payment.

tasks.label: Customers
tasks.text: Contacts, discount, payment term, order history.

tasks.label: Menu and costing
tasks.text: Products with a price and a recipe; the app calculates what one item costs you.

tasks.label: Inventory
tasks.text: Ingredients, semi-finished items and packaging; products are written off by recipe when you take an order, and the app tells you what will run short.

tasks.label: Documents and payment
tasks.text: Delivery note and invoice for the customer, payment marks, debts.

tasks.label: Analytics · Full
tasks.text: Revenue, profit, best-selling products, a team of employees.

connectText: Customer → product in the menu → order. From the order, inventory and documents follow on their own: products are written off and the invoice is built from the items.

steps.title: Add a product
steps.text: “Menu” → “+” → name and “Sale price” → “Save”. You can add a recipe later.

steps.title: Create an order
steps.text: “Orders” → “+” → choose a customer → add a product and quantity → “Save order”.

stepsNote: Then add what you need: recipes and ingredient prices, and the app will calculate the cost.
plansText: Everything is open for the first 7 days. After that there is a free plan up to 50 orders, then Light and Full.
newsText: Short notes on new features of the app.
